title: A hidden entity picking recruits from the GATE pool

tellings.quote: different entity that is utilizing Gate behind the scenes to find a pre-selected pool of people and pull them into the programs

plain: Jordan Jose, who says he was taken into a secret UFO program as a child, believes that some hidden group uses GATE, a school program for gifted and talented children, to recruit people. In his words, a "different entity" works "behind the scenes" to find a pre-selected pool of children and pull them into the programs, which would mean ordinary schooling is used to choose recruits.
